tool_schemas.name: get_service_status
tool_schemas.description: Current version per region, health and error rate of a service.

tool_schemas.name: list_deployments
tool_schemas.description: Release history for a service with health status (oldest first).

tool_schemas.name: rollback
tool_schemas.description: Roll a service back to a previously released version in all production regions.

tool_schemas.name: deploy
tool_schemas.description: Deploy a version of a service to all production regions.

tool_schemas.name: create_incident
tool_schemas.description: Open an incident; this pages the on-call engineer.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. Requests repeated with the same key are executed at most once.

args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy - rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks after the v2.3.1 production deploy (error rate 0.18). Actions taken: (1) Identified v2.3.0 as the most recent production release that was healthy (v2.2.9 and v2.3.0 were healthy; v2.3.1 and v2.3.1-rc were unhealthy). (2) Rolled back to v2.3.0. The first attempt halted after us-east with an orchestrator partial failure, leaving the fleet mixed (us-east v2.3.0, us-west and eu-west v2.3.1). A second rollback attempt completed. (3) Current state: all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) on v2.3.0, healthy=true, error rate 0.002. Follow-ups: investigate the v2.3.1 failure cause, and check the orchestrator partial failure that halted the first rollback attempt.

trace.final:
checkout-api is rolled back to v2.3.0 in all three regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). It is healthy again with an error rate of 0.002, down from 0.18.

- **Target version:** v2.3.0 was the most recent production release marked healthy. v2.3.1 was unhealthy, and v2.3.1-rc was only in staging.
- **Rollback:** The first attempt failed partway through with an orchestrator error. After us-east had moved to v2.3.0, the fleet was left mixed. I retried the same rollback, and it completed across all regions.
- **Incident:** I opened SEV2 incident INC-0001 for checkout-api, which paged the on-call engineer. The summary covers the cause, the rollback steps, the partial failure, and the current state. The first incident request timed out, so I retried with the same idempotency key. The incident was created once.

Follow-ups for the on-call engineer: find the cause of the v2.3.1 failures, and look into the orchestrator partial failure that halted the first rollback attempt.

content.text: The most recent production release that was healthy is v2.3.0. v2.3.1 is the current unhealthy release in all three regions. I'll roll back to v2.3.0.
The rollback reported a partial failure after us-east. I'll check the current state before retrying anything.
The fleet is now mixed: us-east is on v2.3.0, while us-west and eu-west are still on v2.3.1. The rollout halted, so I'll retry the same rollback once to finish it.
The rollback is complete and healthy. Now I'll open the SEV2 incident.
